legal-page-discovery 1.0.0

- Initial release: discover and classify a website’s legal/compliance pages.
- Identifies candidate pages via sitemap(s), robots.txt, footer/nav links on home and deep pages, and direct guesses of common legal URL paths.
- Retrieves and processes each candidate’s full, verbatim text using curl and HTML-to-text extraction.
- Classifies each page’s type, controlling entity, nav label and location, and records salient findings and mismatches.
- Produces a comprehensive manifest for downstream routing and assessment; does not perform compliance review itself.
